meta_title: Where we ship: prices, taxes and shipping by country | OpenDrone
meta_description: Who can buy OpenDrone boards in stock or on pre-order, in which currency, what the price includes and how it ships.
title: Where we ship
lead: One row per market. Choose your country in the header to see your prices.
table_caption: Markets, currency, what the price includes, and shipping
why_prices: Prices: one base price before tax per product. EU prices add VAT. Outside the EU you pay the base price with no EU VAT; import taxes may be due on delivery. US prices add US duties and are duties included.
wholesale: Shops and dealers can apply for wholesale.
notify_title: Not shipping to your country yet? Get notified.
